_ai_assisted: AI-assisted: protocol structure regenerated with Codex under Edu decisions for #137 and #191; reviewed by Edu. Sources rewritten with Claude to cite the primary sources of the team treatment guide, checked against NASA OCHMO-MTB-001 and Gew et al. 2026; reviewed by Javi and Edu.
_integration_status: Activated for confirmed numerical findings. Immediate clinical-priority entry before measurement confirmation remains a separate owner integration; no numerical finding automatically establishes urgency.

route.source: App routing, no medical claim: an episode that is already a medical urgency starts at the urgent steps. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source.

w_red_flags.text: In either eye: a new gap in vision, distortion in the centre, needed lens strength unavailable, sudden vision loss, severe eye pain, or severe headache with signs of a nerve or brain problem?
w_red_flags.source: Gew et al., SANS: expert consensus on diagnosis and management, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6), Table 2: visual field loss, distorted central vision and refractive shifts beyond the glasses' limit. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: sudden vision loss, severe eye pain or severe headache with neurological signs, and using all of these as in-flight urgency signs.

w_escalate.source: Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: at least one severe symptom, or a clinician-declared urgency, makes the episode a medical urgency.

w_notify.text: Notify the crew medical officer. Together, agree on your check-ups and who is responsible for them.
w_notify.source: NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): crews keep regular contact with their doctors. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: agree check-ups and who is responsible.

w_acuity.text: With your clinician, compare vision with prescribed lenses to each eye's pre-flight reference; review eye scans and tests of your whole field of vision if available. Missing or invalid tests are not normal.
w_acuity.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF pp. 6-7: visual acuity, OCT and visual field tests before, during and after flight. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: missing or invalid tests are not normal results.

w_correction.text: Use only prescribed lenses; follow sleep and habitat rules. Clearer vision does not prove swelling is gone; lower-body suction, thigh bands, supplements and acetazolamide (medicine) are for clinicians or research.
w_correction.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF p. 12: space anticipation glasses, at least three pairs of prescription lenses of varying power; lower body negative pressure and thigh cuffs under consideration; B vitamins under study; no medication proven. Gew et al., SANS: expert consensus on diagnosis and management, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6): no established treatment beyond space anticipation glasses. NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF p. 2: impaired sleep and CO2 are possible contributing factors. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: clearer focus does not prove the swelling has resolved.

w_end.text: Keep the follow-up plan agreed with your clinician; no medicine is proven to reverse these spaceflight eye changes. Do not start medicines, pressure-changing treatments or invasive eye procedures from this app.
w_end.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF pp. 12-13: no medication proven for SANS; side effects limit acetazolamide. Gew et al., SANS: expert consensus on diagnosis and management, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6): no established pharmacological treatment. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: nothing is started from this app.

u_stop.text: Stop risky tasks and spacewalks; alert the crew medical officer now. Record when symptoms began and which eye is affected; do not wait for an eye scan.
u_stop.source: Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: stop risky tasks and spacewalks, alert the medical lead, record onset and affected eye; do not wait for an eye scan.

u_env.source: NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): flight surgeons follow each crew during the mission. NASA, Hazard: Distance From Earth [7] (https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/hazard-distance-from-earth/): Earth support is delayed at Mars. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: Earth contact required in Earth orbit and on Mars; on the Moon, care on board and the clinician may request Earth support.

u_ground.text: Send the case summary to the flight surgeons (mission doctors); this app does not send it. Continue local care without waiting for Earth; the clinician decides any return or transfer.
u_ground.source: NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): flight surgeons follow each crew during the mission; return in the crew's spacecraft if an emergency requires it. NASA, Hazard: Distance From Earth [7] (https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/hazard-distance-from-earth/): up to 20 minutes one-way delay at Mars, so crews act with minimal Earth support. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: send the case to Earth in Earth orbit and on Mars; local care does not wait for the reply.

u_end.text: Clinician review and transfer of care are recorded; follow medical limits and follow-up. This does not mean you are cured or cleared for spacewalks; any transfer is a medical and mission decision.
u_end.source: Gew et al., SANS: expert consensus on diagnosis and management, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6): no established treatment beyond space anticipation glasses. NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): return in the crew's spacecraft if an emergency requires it. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: handover is not a cure or spacewalk clearance; restrictions and any transfer are clinical and mission decisions.

u_help.text: Request immediate assistance from the crew medical officer. Do not continue the risky task.
u_help.source: Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: if the risky task cannot be stopped, get immediate help from the on-board medical lead.

w_concern.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF p. 13: optic disc edema of Frisén grade 1 or more, or a 55 µm or greater increase in peripapillary retinal thickness, are indications for a post-flight lumbar puncture. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: using a concern-level finding as an in-flight priority-review trigger.

w_priority_review.text: Ask the crew medical officer for priority medical review of the concerning finding. A concerning number alone does not establish a medical urgency.
w_priority_review.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF pp. 6-7: visual acuity, OCT and visual field tests before, during and after flight. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: priority medical review; a number alone is not an urgency.

w_missing_data.text: Tell the crew medical officer which eye results are unavailable or invalid. Arrange an assessment; without an eye scan, checks for changes inside the eye are incomplete.
w_missing_data.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF pp. 6-7: OCT assesses the retina, choroid and optic nerve head. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: a missing or invalid eye test is reported as not evaluable, never as normal.

u_local.text: Alert the on-board medical lead for an immediate eye, nerve and brain assessment. Do not assume every sudden vision problem is this spaceflight eye condition; the clinician decides care and limits.
u_local.source: Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: immediate eye and neurological assessment; do not assume every sudden vision problem is SANS.

u_support.text: Has the local clinician requested Earth support while local care continues?
u_support.source: NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): flight surgeons follow each crew during the mission. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: on the Moon the local clinician may request Earth support (team decision on #191; keeps Earth support available where the delay allows it).

u_handover.text: Confirm that a clinician has reviewed this episode and accepted responsibility for ongoing care. Select Done only then; otherwise keep this task active and stay assisted.
u_handover.source: Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: a medical urgency stays open until a clinician has reviewed it and accepted responsibility; this is a crew acknowledgement, not an authenticated clinician sign-off.

w_review_outcome.text: Wait here until the clinician completes the priority review. Has the clinician declared a medical urgency?
w_review_outcome.source: Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: after a priority review the clinician, not a number, may declare a medical urgency.

w_symptoms.text: Do you have mild, gradual difficulty focusing or reading?
w_symptoms.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF p. 5: hyperopic shifts can blur near vision. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: mild, gradual difficulty focusing or reading as the watch question.

w_correction_check.text: Has the clinician confirmed that the prescribed lenses you need go beyond the lens strengths available?
w_correction_check.source: Gew et al., SANS: expert consensus on diagnosis and management, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6), Table 2: refractive shifts beyond the glasses' limit. NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), PDF p. 9: crew need optical correction with increased levels of power.

u_no_clinician.text: Keep risky tasks stopped and follow your pre-authorized local emergency protocol without waiting for Earth. This episode stays open until a clinician reviews it and accepts care.
u_no_clinician.source: NASA, Hazard: Distance From Earth [7] (https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/hazard-distance-from-earth/): crews must handle emergencies with minimal Earth support. Team triage proposal [P], no published primary source: while no clinician can accept care, keep risky tasks stopped, follow the pre-authorized local emergency protocol, and keep the urgency open.
